parameter.name: threshold
parameter.invariant_reasoning: Find the blue bounding box, count blue cells by row and column, and fill interior zeros when either count reaches the episode threshold.
parameter.input_constraints: Each retained 9x9 blue mask has row/column counts crossing 3, 4, and 5, so every demonstration distinguishes all allowed settings.

episodes.program_text:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g))
                (bb (bbox-of-cells (find-color g 1)))
                (r1 (first bb))
                (c1 (second bb))
                (r2 (third bb))
                (c2 (fourth bb))
                (row-blues (map (lambda (r) (row-count g r 1)) (range 0 h)))
                (col-blues (map (lambda (c) (col-count g c 1)) (range 0 w))))
           (cellmap g
                    (r c v)
                    (if (= 1 v)
                        1
                        (if (and (>= r r1) (<= r r2) (>= c c1) (<= c c2) (zero? v))
                            (if (or (>= (nth row-blues r) 3) (>= (nth col-blues c) 3))
                                2
                                0)
                            0))))))

limitations: This is an isolated proposal, not a production generator or authority change.
Evidence covers three complete deterministic episodes and only the two declared threshold rivals per episode.
The deliberately diagnostic mask family does not establish identifiability against undeclared alternative rules.
